title: ETL Pipeline Guide — Companion Code
title_es: Guía de pipelines ETL — Código complementario
description: Runnable companion for the ETL pipelines guide: incremental extractor with watermarks, validator/transform pipeline, idempotent upsert loader (sqlite), a reference Airflow 2.x DAG, and SCD Type 2 SQL.
description_es: Complemento ejecutable de la guía de pipelines ETL: extractor incremental con watermarks, pipeline de validadores/transformaciones, cargador upsert idempotente (sqlite), un DAG de referencia de Airflow 2.x y SQL de SCD Tipo 2.
